description: One Rust interface to the coding agents installed on a machine: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode, Kiro, Grok, Hermes, Qwen, pi, Antigravity.
rules: Always start with Runtime::discover(), then report.require(id), then runtime.open(agent, SessionOptions::in_dir(path)). in_dir is required.
Gate features on session.info().details.capabilities.supports(Capability::X), never on the agent's name. Unsupported calls fail with AgentError::UnsupportedFeature.
Read Events from its own task and match on EventKind with a `_ => {}` arm; the enum is #[non_exhaustive].
Answer every RequestOpened exactly once with session.answer(); clear UI on RequestClosed, not on your own answer.
ToolUpdated is a cumulative snapshot: replace the stored tool by id, never merge deltas.
TurnEnded arrives exactly once per turn. Show StopReason::Completed { source: Inferred } as idle, not as success.
Session::configure is confirmed by a SessionUpdated event, not by the call returning.
Read models and options from details.config_options; never hardcode model names.
